records.subject: Welcome aboard, Vantage Ventures
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: Next step after your first project
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

Thanks again for making time for the onboarding call last week, and nice work getting your first project set up. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so adding a few tasks to that project is usually the natural next step.

When you're ready to bring the rest of the team in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to walk through whichever part is most useful.

Best,
Nadia
